reviews.review:
I am enjoying this game a lot. It is an excellent roguelike.
I didn't enjoy the first two hours. I felt compelled to play more because of the good reviews it seemed to be getting, and I didn't want to study at the time so it was a good distraction. The gameplay is all about collecting items to enhance your character while simultaneously balancing the amount of time you spend on the current level, as the difficulty is steadily increasing all the time.
For the first 2 hours I died a lot, so I didn't understand fully the gameplay. I never collected that many powerups, so I assumed that the controller combat was a big part of the gameplay. But it's not really. The game begins to really shine once you have at least 12-20 items. So be aware of this going in. Your first few playthroughs probably won't feel good at all, and will make you think the game is not of a high standard.
Once you collect massive amounts of items you feel like an omnipotent being, destroying swathes of creatures. It's crazy that a 2d game, in which your character is just a bunch of tiny pixels on the screen, can achieve this sense of power in a much greater way than triple A titles can. Fair play to these developers. I think they did a fantastics job.

I love this game. It's challenging, it takes times to master, its so satisfying to win, and it takes roughly an hour to beat a game. Sometimes it feels like a grind but 95% of the times its pure trying to survive, hoping nothing goes wrong or you make a wrong move, and doing your best. I've put a lot of hours into this game. I've moved on from it a little bit at this point but I'm sure I will come back to it. It's always fun to pick a character you thought was trash, find a way to make it work, and master it. 

Great game for a low price.
This is a great game for those who are seeking a fun exploration game with a great deal of challenge. I highly recommend it.
receive this game from my friend, best game that deserve a steam award
